name: RF communication
description: Any board with a radio, antenna or RF transmission line.
placement_rules: Antenna keep-out on every layer per the antenna datasheet
Matching network inline; crystal/TCXO adjacent to the transceiver
Switching regulators away from the RF section
routing_rules: RF feed as 50 ohm microstrip/CPWG from the fabricator stackup
No vias or stubs on the RF trace
Ground via fence along the feed
copper_rules: Unbroken ground under the RF section
No pour in the antenna keep-out
emi_emc_rules: Regulator harmonics out of band; shield can option
verification_requirements: RF width/gap recorded against the fabricator calculator
Keep-out verified as a DRC keep-out
Band plan and module certification recorded
